text: Lieutenant Arin Tavos holds the role of Tactical Operations & Gunnery Chief within Galactic Union (federation). Decision archetype: Direct Combat, Prefers Tactical Overwhelming Firepower.

Core traits: Aggressive Tactician, Highly Skilled in Starship Combat, Calculated Risk-Taker. Voice — tone: aggressive; cadence: crisp. Avoids: passive posture, over-negotiation, hesitancy in engagement.

Assigned to G.U.S. Judicator Prime (Galactic Union Supercarrier). Core values: tactical dominance, firepower superiority, calculated aggression. Faction — military: 0.80, economic: 0.80, technology: 0.70.
